Folded in: its two written name-history accounts (meaning, after Behind the Name; Omar Ahmed Youssouf, Présidence de Djibouti 2017), the spelling Youssouf in Chad, Djibouti and the Comoros (Forebears), the bearer Omar Ahmed Youssouf, its origin claims and its Behind the Name, Présidence and Forebears sources. Not carried: the spelling Yousouf and the Somali and Comorian links, which rested on the candidate queue alone.

Youssef is a transcription of the Arabic Yusuf. Folded in: the spelling Youssef in Egypt, now attested by the Atlantic Council's « Who Are Egypt's New Ministers? » (2015), and its Behind the Name origin claim and source. Not carried: the Arabs of Africa link, which rested on the candidate queue alone.
Osman (and Othman) are forms of the personal name Ousmane, the third caliph's. Folded in: the spellings Osman and Othman and Sudan as a country (candidate queue).

Ally is a variant of Ali (Dictionary of American Family Names). Folded in: the spelling Ally and Tanzania (Office of the Solicitor General), the supposed Swahili link, the DAFN claim and its two sources.
